svg.title: Aurora curriculum
svg.desc: The first twenty levels are hand-authored. Levels 21 to 1000 are generated across ten tiers of 98 levels, from colour and the box model through selectors, flexbox, grid, transforms, gradients, custom properties, responsive design and motion, using 191 puzzle families. Starlight per level rises from 12 to 30.
svg.text: a first rule, padding, hover, flexbox, grid, gradients, variables, keyframes
colour, units, font size, weight, spacing, text-transform
margin, padding, borders, radius, display, overflow
direction, wrap, gap, justify, align, grow and shrink
tracks, repeat, areas, spans, auto-fit, minmax
sticky, absolute, translate, rotate, aspect-ratio, object-fit
linear and radial, layered shadows, blur, clamp, text effects
var, calc, min, max, clamp, color-mix, fallbacks
media queries, container queries, fluid type, mobile first
980 generated levels = 10 tiers × 98. Each tier draws from its own families with a seeded generator, so every build is identical.
